comment: The Gravion model registry — Gravion AI's own models and variants. Status: gravion-core is AVAILABLE (the built-in offline engine every deployment ships with); gravion-chat and gravion-code are AVAILABLE as Tier 2 (Basic) first trained bundles since Piece 2; the remaining specialist models are PLANNED and land with their module pieces (see ARCHITECTURE.md roadmap). A deployment may register private variants by placing its own models.json in the deployment home; the same schema and validation apply.

models.name: Gravion Core
models.notes: The built-in engine inside every Gravion deployment. Runs fully offline — no network, no API key — and carries the deployment's name and company policy in its system context.

models.name: Gravion Chat
models.notes: Gravion's trained conversational model for the chat and support modules — long-context, policy-faithful, tuned for company assistants. Piece 2 ships its first trained bundle at Tier 2 (Basic); the Tier 1 / 3 / 4 bundles land with the tier-packaging pieces (see ARCHITECTURE.md roadmap).

models.name: Gravion Code
models.notes: Gravion's code model for the coder module: generation, review and explanation across a deployment's own stack. Piece 2 ships its first trained bundle at Tier 2 (Basic); the Tier 1 / 3 / 4 bundles land with the tier-packaging pieces (see ARCHITECTURE.md roadmap).

models.name: Gravion Builder
models.notes: Gravion's site-building model: turns a company brief into a full website and iterates on feedback.

models.name: Gravion Vision
models.notes: Gravion's image model: generation and editing for brand, product and interface work.

models.name: Gravion Video
models.notes: Gravion's video model. Long-form output (up to ~1 hour, high quality) is produced by the video module's scene-planning and stitching pipeline on top of this model — see ARCHITECTURE.md.

models.name: Gravion Audio
models.notes: Gravion's music and sound model: tracks, jingles and background scores.

models.name: Gravion Shield
models.notes: Gravion's security model for the cyber module: defensive analysis, triage and reporting assistance, built from the author's own security research practice.

models.name: Gravion Agent
models.notes: Gravion's agentic model: plans and runs tool-using workflows, and builds agents for repeatable work.

models.name: Gravion Omni
models.notes: The all-in-one flagship: one Gravion model serving every capability, offered at the Advanced tier for deployments that want a single model behind every module.
